purpose: Add deterministic fixed x/y translation mounts around the preserved AXM Physics Core so one body can carry another at an explicit offset without claiming rotational weld or angular-joint behavior.

properties.mounts: bounded array of explicit fixed-offset translation constraints
properties.options: optional bounded pre/post position and velocity iteration counts

relationships.basis: Distance joints preserve scalar separation while translation mounts preserve the full world-axis x/y offset.

limitations: fixed world-axis x/y translation offset only
mount offsets do not rotate with bodies
no angular inertia, angular response or rotational weld semantics
connected mounted bodies can still collide unless caller collision filters suppress the pair
post-core projection can move bodies after core-stage contact evidence was generated
persistent_state: mount definitions are explicit caller-owned JSON data

proves: truthful handling of two immovable bodies

truth.basis: The capability is explicitly translation-only and does not call itself a rotational weld or rigid-body angular joint.

agency.basis: Mount endpoints, offset, correction bounds and iteration counts remain explicit caller-controlled data.

continuity.basis: The imported AXM Physics Core v0.3.1 donor source is not modified; the mount solver is an additive UC layer.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: This adds a narrow mount primitive that is useful for carried equipment and modular assemblies without jumping ahead to unsupported rotation or full weld joints.
